title: Islam Se Pehle Arab Muashre Ke Pehlu

topics.title: Arabon Ki Samaji Zindagi

paragraphs.text: Arabia ki mazhabi aur siyasi zindagi par tehqeeq karne ke baad munasib hai ke wahan rayij samaji, maashi aur akhlaqi halaat ke baare mein mukhtasar baat ki jaye.

Arab muashra ek samaji milawat pesh karta tha, jis mein mukhtalif aur ghair mutajanis samaji tabqaat the. Sharif khaandanon mein aurat ka maqaam izzat ki ek aala darja par tha. Aurat ko kaafi had tak azaad iraade ki sahuliyat hasil thi, aur aksar uska faisla nafiz kiya jaata. Use itni qadar ki nazar se dekha jaata ke uski izzat ke difaa mein aasani se khoon baha diya jaata. Dar haqeeqat, woh khoonrez jang ya dostana sulah ki sab se faisla-kun kunji thi. In imtiyazaat ke bawajood, Arabia mein khaandani nizaam mukammal tor par pidar-saalari (patriarchal) tha. Nikah ka muaahida mukammal tor par aurat ke qanooni sarparast ke haathon mein tha, jiske alfaaz uski azdawaji haisiyat ke baare mein kabhi mehl-e-sawaal nahin ho sakte the.

Doosri taraf, kuch aise samaji tabqaat the jahan zina-kaari aur bay-hayaai aam aur poori tarah jaari thi. Abu Da'ud ne, 'Aishah (Allah un se raazi ho) ke hawale se, Islam se pehle ke Arabia mein chaar qism ke nikah bayan kiye: Pehla aaj ke nikah ke tareeqon jaisa tha, jis mein ek shakhs apni beti ki shaadi kisi doosre shakhs se haq-mehr tay karne ke baad karta. Doosre mein, shauhar apni biwi ko – haiz ki muddat ke baad – kisi doosre mard ke saath hum-bistari ke liye bhej deta taake woh haamla ho jaye. Haml ke baad, agar shauhar chaahta to woh us se jinsi taalluq qaaim karta. Teesri qism yeh thi ke das se kam mardon ka ek giroh ek aurat se jinsi taalluq qaaim karta. Agar woh haamla ho kar bachcha jane to woh in mardon ko bulwa bhejti, aur koi inkaar nahin kar sakta tha. Woh sab uske ghar jama ho jaate. Woh kehti: 'Tum jaante ho tum ne kya kiya hai. Maine ek bachche ko janam diya hai aur yeh tumhara bachcha hai' (un mein se ek ki taraf ishaara karte hue). Jis mard ka qasad kiya jaata use qubool karna parta. Chauthi qism yeh thi ke bahut se mard ek khaas aurat (kasbi) se jinsi taalluq qaaim karte. Woh kisi ko nahin rokti. Aisi auraten apne darwaazon par ek khaas jhanda lagaya karti theen taake jo bhi chaahe andar aa sake. Agar yeh kasbi haamla ho kar bachcha janti, to woh in mardon ko jama karti, aur ek qaafa-shanaas batati ke yeh kis ka bachcha hai. Muqarrar kiya gaya baap bachche ko le leta aur use apna qaraar de deta. Jab Nabi Muhammad ﷺ ne Arabia mein Islam ka ailaan kiya, to aap ﷺ ne in tamaam jinsi taalluqaat ki sooraton ko mansookh kar diya siwaaye maujooda Islami nikah ke.

Auraten hamesha mardon ke saath unki jangon mein jaati theen. Faateheen aisi auraton se aazadana jinsi taalluq qaaim karte, lekin is tarah haamla hone wale bachchon ko saari umar ruswaai ka saamna karna parta.

Islam se pehle ke Arabon ke paas biwiyon ki koi mehdood tadaad nahin thi. Woh ek hi waqt mein do bahnon se shaadi kar sakte the, ya apne baapon ki biwiyon se bhi agar woh mutallaqa ya bewa hotin. Talaq bahut hi badi had tak shauhar ke ikhtiyaar mein thi.

Zina ki fahaashi taqreeban tamaam samaji tabqaat mein rayij thi siwaaye chand mardon aur auraton ke jinki khud-daari unhein aisa amal karne se rokti thi. Azaad auraten un londiyon (female slaves) se kaheen behtar haalat mein theen jo sab se badi museebat ka shikaar theen. Aisa lagta tha ke Islam se pehle ke Arabon ki badi aksariyat is fahaashi ke irtikaab par sharminda nahin hoti thi. Abu Da'ud ne riwayat ki: Ek shakhs Nabi Muhammad ﷺ ke saamne khada hua aur kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi! woh larka mera beta hai. Maine Islam se pehle ke daur mein uski maa se jinsi taalluq qaaim kiya tha." Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Islam mein Islam se pehle ke maamlaat ka koi daawa nahin. Bachcha us ka manaa jaayega jiske bistar par woh paida hua, aur zina karne wale ke liye sangsaari (stoning) hai."

Islam se pehle ke Arab ke apni aulaad ke saath taalluq ke baare mein, hum dekhte hain ke Arabia mein zindagi mutazaad thi aur tazaadon ki ek tareek tasveer pesh karti thi. Jahan kuch Arab bachchon ko apne dilon mein azeez rakhte aur unhein bahut qadar ki nazar se dekhte, wahin doosre apni bachchiyon ko zinda dafan kar dete kyunki ghurbat aur sharm ka ek mauhoom khauf un par bhaari rehta tha. Magar bachchiyon ko zinda dafan karne ke amal ko poori tarah aam nahin samjha ja sakta, kyunki unhein apne dushmanon se hifazat ke liye mard bachchon ki sakht zaroorat thi.

Arabon ki zindagi ka ek aur pehlu jo zikr ke laaiq hai woh badawi ka apne khaandaan (qabeele) se gehra jazbaati lagaao tha. Khaandaan, ya shaayad qabaili-fakhr, uski sab se mazboot janoon mein se ek tha. Khoon ki wahdat ka aqeeda, ek aise usool ke tor par jo Arabon ko ek samaji wahdat mein baandhta tha, qabaili-fakhr se banta aur uski himayat hoti thi. Unka na-qaabil-e-tardeed naara tha: "Apne bhai ki madad karo chaahe woh zaalim ho ya mazloom" iske lafzi mafhoom mein; woh us Islami tarmeem ko nazar-andaaz karte the jo kehti hai ke zaalim bhai ki madad ka matlab use ziyadti se rokna hai.

Sardaari ki hawas aur muqaable ka teez ehsaas aksar ek hi mushtaraka jadd-e-amjad se nasab rakhne ke bawajood talkh qabaili jangon ka sabab banta. Is silsile mein, Aws aur Khazraj, 'Abs aur Dhubyan, Bakr aur Taghlib waghaira ke musalsal khoonrez jhagde namaaya misaalein hain.

Musalsal qabaili khaja-takka jangon ki wajah se baahami qabaili taalluqaat naazuk aur kamzor the. Magar mazhabi tawahhumaat se gehri aqeedat aur kuch riwaayaat jinki taazeem ki jaati thi, unke khoon ki pyaas bujhaane ke jazbaati rujhaan ko qaaboo mein rakhti theen. Doosri sooraton mein, ittehaad, wafadaari aur enhesaar ke mahrikaat aur unki izzat hoti thi jo kamyabi se hum-aahangi ki rooh paida kar sakte aur jhagde ki be-buniyaad buniyaadon ko khatam kar sakte the. Mumnoo'a mahinon (Muharram, Rajab, Dhul-Qa'dah, aur Dhul-Hijjah) ke dauraan dushmaniyon ko muattal rakhne ki ek qadeem riwayat moafiq tor par kaam karti aur unhein apni rozi kamaane aur aman se sath rehne ka mauqa faraaham karti.

Hum Arabia ki samaji soorat-e-haal ko yun khulasa kar sakte hain ke Islam se pehle ke daur ke Arab andhere aur jihaalat mein tatol rahe the, tawahhumaat ke ek jaal mein phanse hue jo unke zehn ko maa'oof kar deta aur unhein janwar jaisi zindagi guzaarne par majboor karta. Aurat ek bikaau jins thi aur use ek be-jaan jaaidaad ke tukde ki tarah samjha jaata. Baahami qabaili taalluqaat naazuk the. Daulat ki hawas aur faltu jangon mein mulawwas hona woh asal maqaasid the jo unke sardaaron ki khud-gharz policiyon par hukmrani karte the.

topics.topicSummary: Islam se pehle ka Arab muashra gehri tarah mutazaad tha — sharif khaandanon mein auraton ko kuch izzat hasil thi magar aakhir-kaar woh mard sarparaston ke qaaboo mein theen, jabke neeche ke tabqaat mein bay-hayaai aam thi. Qabaili fakhr shadeed tha, bachchiyon ka qatl bachchon se gehri muhabbat ke saath-saath maujood tha, aur baahami qabaili jangein musalsal jaari theen. Islam se pehle ki chaar qism ki 'nikah' sab Islam ne mansookh kar deen siwaaye jaaiz muaahide ke.

Islam ek aise muashre mein aaya jo andhere mein tatol raha tha — auraton ko jaaidaad samjha jaata, qabeele musalsal jang mein the

topics.title: Maashi Soorat-e-Haal

paragraphs.text: Maashi soorat-e-haal samaji mahaul ke mutabiq chalti thi. Arabon ke tarz-e-zindagi is mazhar ko kaafi wazaahat se zaahir karte the.

Tijaarat unki zindagi ki zarooriyaat poori karne ka sab se aam zariya thi. Tijaarati safar tab tak mumkin nahin ho sakte the jab tak qaafilon ke raaston ki hifazat aur baahami qabaili pur-aman bod-o-baash faraaham na ho – do laazmi zaroorein jo afsos ke saath Arabia mein mauf nadaarad theen siwaaye mumnoo'a mahinon ke jin ke andar Arab apne 'Ukaz, Dhil-Majaz, Mijannah aur doosre ijtimaa'aat munaqid karte the.

Sanaat Arab nafsiyat ke liye ajnabi thi. Arabia mein dastiyab tar bunaai aur dabaagh-gari (tannage) ki sanaat zyadatar Yemen, Heerah aur Syria ki sarhadon se aane wale log karte the. Arabia ke andar kuch had tak khaiti-baadi aur maweshi-paalan tha. Taqreeban tamaam Arab auraten soot katne ka kaam karti theen, lekin yeh amal bhi musalsal jangon ki wajah se khatre mein rehta tha. Mojooman, ghurbat, bhook aur na-kaafi libaas maashi tor par Arabia ki rayij khasoosiyat theen.

topics.topicSummary: Arabia ki maeeshat taqreeban poori tarah tijaarati qaafilon par munhasir thi, jo qabaili be-amni ki wajah se musalsal khatre mein rehte. Sanaat taqreeban na-paid thi — zyadatar maaharatana hunar Yemen, Heerah aur Syria ke bahar wale log anjaam dete the. Ghurbat, bhook aur libaas ki qillat Islam se pehle ke Arabia ki roz-marra maashi haqeeqat ko bayan karti thi.
keyPoints: Tijaarati qaafile Arabia mein rozi ka asal zariya the
Tijaarat sirf mumnoo'a mahinon ke dauraan mehfooz tareeqe se chal sakti thi — baqi saal bahut khatarnaak tha
Aham tijaarati ijtimaa'aat mein 'Ukaz, Dhil-Majaz aur Mijannah shaamil the

Mojooman: ghurbat, bhook aur na-kaafi libaas Arabia ki rayij maashi khasoosiyat theen

Islam se pehle ke Arabia mein dastiyab tar sanaat kaun anjaam dete the?
options: Yemen, Heerah aur Syria ki sarhadon se aane wale log
Persia aur Byzantium ke aane wale log
quiz.answer: Yemen, Heerah aur Syria ki sarhadon se aane wale log

topics.title: Akhlaqiyaat

paragraphs.text: Hum is se inkaar nahin kar sakte ke Islam se pehle ke Arabon mein buraaiyon ka itna bada zakheera tha. Bila-shubha, woh aib aur buraaiyaan jo aql se poori tarah radd ki jaati hain, Islam se pehle ke Arabon mein aam theen, lekin yeh kabhi un hairat-angez tor par maujood bahut qaabil-e-tareef khasaail ko nahin chhupa sakta, jin mein se hum mandarja-zail pesh kar sakte hain.

Mehmaan-nawaazi: Woh mehmaan-nawaazi mein ek doosre se muqaabla karte aur is par bohot fakhr karte the. Unke ash'aar ke wirse ka taqreeban aadha hissa mehmaan ki khaatir-tawaazo se wabasta khoobiyon aur sharaafat ke liye waqf tha. Woh sakhi aur mehmaan-nawaaz the had se barh kar. Woh apni zaati rozi ek thande ya bhooke mehmaan par qurbaan kar dete. Woh sirf khoonrezi rokne ke liye, aur natije mein tareef aur taarif paane ke liye, bhaari khoon-baha aur mutaalliqa bojh utha lene mein bhi nahin jhijhakte the.

Mehmaan-nawaazi ke silsile mein, unki sharaab peene ki aam aadtein ubharti hain jise sakhaawat aur mehmaan-nawaazi se nikalne wali ek shaakh samjha jaata tha. Sharaab-noshi Islam se pehle ke daur ke Arabon ke liye fakhr ka ek asli zariya thi. Us daur ke bade shaayar apne mu'allaqaat mein woh sab se aaraasta misray shaamil karna kabhi nahin bhoolte the jo sharaab-noshi ki bazm ke ghuroor aur tareef se labrez hote. Yahan tak ke Arabi mein lafz 'angoor' sakhaawat ke saath talaffuz aur hijje dono mein yaksan hai. Jua bhi unka ek aur amal tha jo sakhaawat se qareeb se wabasta tha kyunki aamdani hamesha khairaat mein jaati. Yahan tak ke Qur'an-e-Kareem bhi sharaab-noshi aur jue se haasil hone wale fawaaid ko kam nahin karta, balke yeh bhi kehta hai: "Aur in ka gunaah un ke fayde se bada hai." [2:219]

Ahad ka paas-rakhna: Arab ke liye, waada karna qarz mein parna tha. Woh apne bachchon ki maut ya apne ghar ki tabaahi ko kabhi gawaara kar leta sirf ahad-paasdaari ki gehri jadd-pakad riwayat ko bar-qaraar rakhne ke liye. Us daur ka adab is khoobi ko ujaagar karne wali kahaniyon se mala-maal hai.

Izzat ka ehsaas aur na-insaafi ki muzaammat: Yeh siffat bunyaadi tor par be-panaah shujaat, khud-daari ke teez ehsaas aur josh se phootti thi. Arab zillat ya susti ke kam-az-kam ishaare ke khilaaf bhi hamesha baghaawat par hota. Woh apne hamesha bedaar khud-ehtraami ke ehsaas ko bar-qaraar rakhne ke liye apne aap ko qurbaan karne mein kabhi nahin jhijhakta.
Mazboot iraada aur azm: Ek Arab kabhi bhi fakhr ke kisi maqsad ya izzat ke kisi maqaam ki taraf le jaane wale raaste ko nahin chhodta, chaahe yeh uski jaan ki keemat par hi kyun na ho.
Burdbaari, sabr aur naram-mizaaji: Arab in khaslaton ko badi tahseen ki nazar se dekhta, jis mein koi ajab nahin, kyunki uski joshili aur shujaat par mabni zindagi afsos ke saath in se khaali thi.

Pakeeza aur saada badawi zindagi, jo abhi tak shehri zindagi ke fareb-deh dikhawe ke lawazimat se daghdar nahin hui thi, uski sachchaai aur diyaanat-daari ki fitrat, aur sazish aur dhoke se laa-taalluqi ki ek mahrik wajah thi.

Aise be-baha akhlaqiyaat, Arabia ki moafiq joghrafiyaai position ke saath mil kar, dar haqeeqat woh awaamil the jo Arabon ko (Islam ke) Paighaam pahunchaane ka bojh uthaane aur insaaniyat ko zindagi ke ek naye raaste par chalane ke liye muntakhab karne ke peeche the.

Is silsile mein, yeh akhlaqiyaat khud, agarche kuch shobon mein nuqsaan-deh aur baaz pehluon mein tasheeh ki mohtaaj, dar haqeeqat insaani muashre ki aakhri bhalaai ke liye bohot qeemti theen aur Islam ne ise mukammal tor par kar diya.

Ahad-paasdaari ke baad sab se be-baha akhlaqiyaat be-shak unka khud-daari ka ehsaas aur mazboot azm the, do aise insaani khaslatein jo ek taraf burai se larne aur akhlaqi fasaad ko mitaane ke liye, aur doosri taraf ek achche aur insaaf-pasand muashre ko qaaim karne ke liye na-guzeer hain.
Dar haqeeqat, Islam se pehle ke daur mein Arabon ki zindagi an-ginat doosri khoobiyon se mala-maal thi jinhein hamein filhaal ginaane ki zaroorat nahin.

topics.topicSummary: Buraaiyon ke aam hone ke bawajood, Islam se pehle ke Arabon mein qaabil-e-qadar khoobiyaan theen — khud ko qurbaan kar dene ki had tak mehmaan-nawaazi, na-taqraar ahad-paasdaari, izzat ka shadeed ehsaas, mazboot iraada aur badawi sadgi se paida hone wali fitri diyaanat. Yahi siffaat, jo Islam ne sanwaarin aur durust rukh par lageen, theek wahi wajah theen jin ki bina par Arabon ko aakhri ilaahi Paighaam ke haamil ke tor par muntakhab kiya gaya.
keyPoints: Islam se pehle ke Arabon mein apni buraaiyon ke saath-saath sachchi qaabil-e-tareef khoobiyaan theen
Mehmaan-nawaazi unka sab se bada fakhr tha — taqreeban aadhi Arabi shaayri ne ise saraaha
Sharaab aur jua unki saqaafat mein sakhaawat se jude the — Qur'an ne unke fawaaid ko tasleem kiya magar farmaaya ke 'gunaah bada hai' [2:219]
Ahad-paasdaari muqaddas thi — ek Arab waada todne ke bajaaye apne bachche aur ghar qurbaan kar deta
Izzat ka ehsaas, mazboot iraada, sachchaai aur dhoke se laa-taalluqi buniyaadi Arab khoobiyaan theen
Yeh akhlaqiyaat, Arabia ki joghrafiyaai position ke saath mil kar, woh aham wajahein theen jin par Arabon ko Islam ka Paighaam uthaane ke liye chuna gaya
Islam ne in khoobiyon ko tabaah nahin kiya — usne unhein sanwaara aur insaaf aur haq ki taraf morha
